name: nc_core_rates
description: North Carolina MEDICAID (not Medicare) FQHC and rural health clinic (RHC) T1015 core-service per-visit encounter rates, PER PROVIDER (NPI and location, with PPS or cost-based basis and begin/end dates), from NC DHHS Division of Health Benefits. The downloadable per-provider schedules cover 2020 and 2021; later (2023 PPS and alternative payment model) schedules sit in a separate NC fee-schedule portal this tool does not read, so figures are old and data_as_of says so. Filter by clinic name fragment or 10-digit NPI, by program, schedule, or the date a rate was in force.

provider.description: Clinic name fragment (names are cut off at ~35 characters in the publication) or a 10-digit NPI.

schedule.description: "latest" (default), "2021-07-01" or "2020-03-31" (the schedule effective dates; see nc_rate_periods).

effective_on.description: A date (YYYY-MM-DD): return the rate span in force that day (2019-2021 spans are published).

include_history.description: Return every published span in the schedule, not only those open-ended when published.

limit.description: Max rows (default 25, max 200). Summaries cover all providers in the selection.

name: nc_rate_periods
description: List the NC Medicaid FQHC and RHC core-service rate schedules available (effective dates, publication update date, provider counts) and say what is not covered (rates after 2021).

program.description: One program, or omit for both.
